name: Hubstaff Tasks
description_en:
Hubstaff Tasks is the Kanban/sprint task application in the Hubstaff family. It organizes projects, task cards, workflow steps, assignments, Epics and work logs. Hubstaff Time Tracking is a related product that adds deeper time/cost reporting and other workforce operations; Hubstaff Talent is a separate hiring service. Their names and navigation should not become one combined feature entitlement.

There are also two documented adoption paths: standalone Tasks plans and Tasks embedded as a Time Tracking add-on. Pricing, timer behavior, invitations and unlinking consequences differ. This documentation-based profile follows those boundaries; it does not report a live board, time session, payroll result or successful integration.
description_zh:
Hubstaff Tasks 是 Hubstaff 家族中的 Kanban／冲刺任务应用，用于组织项目、任务卡片、流程阶段、分派、Epic 和工作日志。Hubstaff Time Tracking 是相关产品，提供更深入的时间／成本报告及其他劳动力运营能力；Hubstaff Talent 则是独立招聘服务，不能把它们的名称和导航合并成一份功能权益。

文档也存在两条采用路径：独立 Tasks 方案，以及嵌入 Time Tracking 的 Tasks 附加组件。价格、计时器行为、邀请和解除关联结果有所不同。以下基于文档核对这些边界，没有声称实际看板、工时会话、工资结果或集成成功。

core_features.explanation_en: Configured workflow can move a task and assign its next owner.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置流程可移动任务并分派下一负责人。

core_features.explanation_en: Project inclusion and task type/recurrence affect sprint use.
core_features.explanation_zh: 项目参与设置及任务类型／重复影响冲刺使用。

core_features.explanation_en: Standalone and linked time tracking use different timer conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 独立及关联工时采用不同计时条件。

en: Pilot a small issue workflow and reconcile one known interval under the intended standalone/add-on path.
zh: 试点小型问题流程，并按目标独立／附加组件路径核对一个已知时段。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation, not measured delivery or ROI.

Product boundary.en: Hosted Tasks app; Time Tracking integration/add-on has separate billing and data lifecycle.
Product boundary.zh: 托管 Tasks 应用；Time Tracking 集成／附加组件有独立计费及数据生命周期。

steps.en: Confirm whether adopting standalone Tasks or an embedded Time Tracking add-on and inspect billing/data exit conditions.
steps.zh: 确认采用独立 Tasks 还是嵌入 Time Tracking 的附加组件，并检查计费及数据退出条件。

steps.en: Pilot one card transition and verify actual assignee, sprint and timer behavior.
steps.zh: 试点一次卡片转换，核对实际负责人、冲刺及计时行为。

integrations.scope: Hubstaff Time Tracking documented; no project link, identity synchronization or external operation tested.

items.en: Unlinking embedded Tasks is documented to delete the Tasks organization/data immediately.
items.zh: 文档称解除嵌入 Tasks 会立即删除 Tasks 组织／数据。

items.en: Sprint tasks disable recurring and linked projects disable Tasks Web Timer.
items.zh: 冲刺任务禁用重复，关联项目禁用 Tasks Web Timer。

license.scope: Vendor retains software/source rights; not self-host or open-source grant.

sections.title_en: Define what a transition should change
sections.title_zh: 定义阶段转换应改变什么
sections.en:
For a hypothetical website issue, create a card with the reproduction context, owner, acceptance checklist and due date. Put it through a small Ready → Doing → Review workflow. Hubstaff Tasks describes custom board columns and a workflow action that moves work and assigns the next people. A transition is useful only if its destination and owner match the team’s process.

Inspect one transition and a returned-for-correction item before copying the workflow widely. A one-click move does not prove the fix passed review. Timeline and Roadmap are alternative planning views with plan conditions, rather than independent evidence that dates or staffing estimates are achievable. No issue or workflow button was created.
sections.zh:
假设处理网站问题，可创建带复现背景、负责人、验收清单和到期日的卡片，沿 Ready → Doing → Review 小流程移动。Hubstaff Tasks 描述自定义看板列，以及移动工作并分派下一批人员的流程动作。只有目标位置和负责人符合团队流程，转换才有用。

广泛复制前应检查一次转换及一项退回修正的工作。一键移动不证明修复通过复核。Timeline 和 Roadmap 是带方案条件的规划视图，不能独立证明日期或人员估算可实现。本次未创建问题或流程按钮。

sections.title_en: A sprint assignment has its own conditions
sections.en:
The sprint guide allows periods from one to seven weeks and up to four active sprints. Projects must be included in sprints before their tasks appear in that planning view. Icebox tasks do not show the Sprint dropdown, and recurring is disabled for tasks added to a sprint.

For a pilot, compare a normal project task, an Icebox item and a repeated task before assuming they can all enter the same sprint unchanged. A missed deadline, backlog membership and task completion are different decisions. Inspect the organization/project selected and keep one expected sample outside the filter so a hidden item is not mistaken for deletion. The guide’s view labels were read, not tested in an account.
sections.zh:
冲刺指南允许一至七周周期，最多四个活跃冲刺。项目需启用参与冲刺，其任务才会进入该规划视图。Icebox 任务不显示 Sprint 下拉菜单，加入冲刺的任务也会禁用重复。

试点应比较普通项目任务、Icebox 项及重复任务，再判断它们是否能不变地进入同一冲刺。错过期限、进入待办和任务完成是不同决定。应检查所选组织／项目，并在筛选外保留一个预期样本，避免把隐藏项误认成删除。本次读取了视图标签，没有在账户测试。

sections.title_en: Linking Time Tracking changes the timer path
sections.title_zh: 关联 Time Tracking 会改变计时路径
sections.en:
The standalone product page describes an in-app timer, manual work logs and Epic totals built from tasks. The support guide says linked projects deactivate the Tasks Web Timer and use timer-app data for the Worked value. Although the same guide also describes synchronous timers, its explicit linked-project restriction means the exact account path must be demonstrated. The embedded add-on guide also excludes direct Tasks Web Timer use.

Compare one known interval with its task, work log and project identity. An estimated duration and actual Worked time are different fields. Cost requires the synchronized organization/project and a user pay rate; it is not automatically revenue, margin or an approved client invoice. No time, rate, budget or accounting calculation was executed.
sections.zh:
独立产品页描述内置计时器、手动工作日志及从任务累加的 Epic 工时。支持指南称关联项目会停用 Tasks Web Timer，以计时应用数据填入 Worked。虽然同篇也描述计时器同步，但明确的关联项目限制意味着需演示具体账户路径；嵌入附加组件指南同样排除直接使用 Tasks Web Timer。

应将一个已知时段与任务、日志及项目身份比较。估算时长和实际 Worked 是不同字段。成本需要同步组织／项目并设置用户支付费率，不会自动等于收入、利润或已批准客户发票。本次未执行工时、费率、预算或会计计算。

sections.title_en: Count the owner in standalone pricing
sections.title_zh: 独立版计费包含所有者
sections.en:
The standalone support table lists Free for up to five users, ten projects,100MB/user and three open Epics. Premium lists USD5/user/month or USD50/user/year, with unlimited projects,5GB/user and features such as recurring tasks, stand-ups, Timelines and Roadmaps. The owner counts as a user and every plan starts with a fourteen-day Premium trial.

On that published model, six billable people including the owner total USD30/month or USD300/year before other charges; this is a calculation, not a quote. Added users are prorated and removed users’ unused time becomes a future bill credit. The current pricing landing page and browser do not display an amount table. Confirm current standalone enrollment, tax, limits and cycle in the intended account rather than treating a surviving help table as a completed purchase.
sections.zh:
独立版支持表列出免费版最多五位用户、十个项目、每用户 100 MB 及三个未关闭 Epic。Premium 列出每用户每月 5 美元或每年 50 美元，含不限项目、每用户 5 GB，以及重复任务、站会、Timeline 和 Roadmap 等功能。所有者也算用户，每个方案先进行十四天 Premium 试用。

按该公开模型，包含所有者的六位收费用户在其他费用前合计每月 30 美元或每年 300 美元，这是算例，不是报价。新增用户按比例计费，移除用户未用时间转为后续账单抵扣。当前定价入口和浏览器均未显示金额表。应在目标账户确认独立注册、税费、限制及周期，不能把仍存在的帮助表当作已完成购买。

sections.title_en: An add-on trial is not the standalone free plan
sections.title_zh: 附加组件试用不是独立免费方案
sections.en:
The combined guide describes Tasks as a paid Starter add-on and included with Grow and above. Its activation and billing rules therefore need to be checked against the Time Tracking subscription. The add-on support page says existing unlinked projects become linked after activation, invite-link users are not automatically invited into Tasks, and add-ons are automatically billed after trial. It also contains wording about confirming continuation after trial; clarify the actual billing state.

Most consequentially, the guide says unlinking immediately deletes the Tasks organization/data. Treat unlinking as an exit/data operation, not a harmless switch. Before it is considered, obtain applicable export/recovery instructions and inspect an independent usable copy. No add-on was enabled or unlinked, and no automatic migration or recovery guarantee was established.
sections.zh:
组合指南将 Tasks 描述为 Starter 的付费附加组件，Grow 及以上包含。因此需结合 Time Tracking 订阅核对激活及收费。附加组件支持页称激活后已有未关联项目会关联，邀请链接加入的用户不会自动进入 Tasks，附加组件试用后自动收费；同页又有试用后确认继续的文字，实际账单状态需澄清。

更关键的是，指南称解除关联会立即删除 Tasks 组织／数据。这是退出及数据操作，不是无害开关。考虑解除前，应取得适用导出／恢复说明并检查独立可用副本。本次未启用或解除附加组件，也未确立自动迁移或恢复保证。

sections.title_en: Validate permissions and exit before widening the board
sections.title_zh: 扩大看板前验证权限及退出
sections.en:
Hubstaff Tasks is a plausible shortlist for a team that wants board transitions and sprint planning, especially if it also needs a deliberately configured Time Tracking link. A team needing only a private checklist should evaluate the added setup and subscription path first. Vendor productivity and ROI statements were not treated as independent results.

Use two appropriately scoped test roles to inspect one permitted task update and one denied edit, then a correction and an exit copy. Exact task trash, restore completeness and retention were not established. The public Hubstaff terms reserve its software/source rights; access is a service license, not an open-source or self-host grant. A getting-started page returned429 and was not bypassed. No permissions, account creation or data change was performed.
sections.zh:
需要看板阶段转换和冲刺规划的团队可以考虑 Hubstaff Tasks，特别是明确需要且愿意配置 Time Tracking 关联时。仅需私人清单的团队应先评估附加配置及订阅路径。厂商生产力和 ROI 文字未当作独立结果。

可用两个权限范围明确的测试角色检查一次允许更新及一次拒绝编辑，再检查修正及退出副本。本次未确立任务回收站、恢复完整性及保留期。公开 Hubstaff 条款保留软件／源码权利，服务访问不等于开源或自托管授权。一篇入门页返回 429，未绕过。本次未改变权限、创建账户或修改数据。

What happens when the add-on is unlinked?
